leg.text: Jedit Ojanen is a cat warrior who leaves the forests of his tribe, takes service with the Robaran Mercenaries, and rises through their ranks to lead them in the battle for Efrava.
He saves Johan from a sand wurm, but when he sees Jaeger's medallion on Johan he realizes that Johan killed his father, and he joins Adira's Circle of Seven against him.

He visits the Dark Heart in Scarwood, learns the history of the cat warriors, and slays its guardian Ur-Drago, though he is gravely wounded, and he later wins the support of other cat tribes for Efrava.

When Johan attacks Efrava, Jedit leads guerrilla warfare as general, and in the final confrontation Johan kills Adira but falls with Jedit to the desert, where a sand wurm eats Johan, after which Jedit becomes chief of the Robarans.

mir.text: In Mirage, Johan reaches Efrava disguised as a human and uses a charm to manipulate Jedit Ojanen into pleading to be his guardian, but his treachery is discovered and he flees west with Jedit in pursuit.

Jedit saves Johan from a sand wurm, but at Palmyra Johan deceives him and unleashes his bloodlust against Hazezon and Adira, until the Robarans reveal that Jaeger was their friend and Jedit nearly kills Johan.

In the final confrontation Johan slays Adira but is dragged from the sky by Jedit and devoured by a colossal sand wurm, ending the war, after which Jedit leads the Robarans into a new era of expansion and the reunited tiger tribes to the Scarwood.
